CABO DE PALOS (CARTAGENA)

CALBLANQUE NATURAL PARK
This park is a paradise of pristine beaches, golden dunes and rugged mountains. Calblanque stands out for its biodiversity and undisturbed landscapes, being a perfect natural refuge for hikers and nature lovers. Its coast is wild and quiet, far from mass tourism.

THE MINES AND THE VILLAGE OF PORTMÁN
A place where the mining history of the region comes to life. Portmán, famous for its past in mineral extraction, is a testament to the rise and fall of the mining industry. The abandoned mines and the partially reclaimed bay are a reflection of its legacy.

LA MANGA DEL MAR MENOR
A stretch of land that separates the Mar Menor from the Mediterranean, La Manga is famous for its endless beaches and its sports offering, especially for water sports enthusiasts. With a salt lagoon of warm waters, it is an idyllic destination for sun and beach tourism.

CABO DE PALOS (CARTAGENA)
Un pintoresco pueblo de pescadores con un faro icónico, Cabo de Palos es conocido por sus aguas cristalinas, ideales para el buceo y el snorkel, además de su vibrante puerto y restaurantes de mariscos frescos. El entorno marino, protegido, ofrece un espectáculo de vida submarina incomparable.

PARQUE NATURAL DE CALBLANQUE
Este parque es un paraíso de playas vírgenes, dunas doradas y montañas escarpadas. Calblanque destaca por su biodiversidad y paisajes inalterados, siendo un refugio natural perfecto para senderistas y amantes de la naturaleza. Su costa es salvaje y tranquila, alejada del turismo masivo.

LAS MINAS Y EL PUEBLO DE PORTMÁN
Un lugar donde la historia minera de la región cobra vida. Portmán, famoso por su pasado en la extracción de minerales, es un testimonio del auge y caída de la industria minera. Las minas abandonadas y la bahía parcialmente recuperada son reflejo de su legado.

LA MANGA DEL MAR MENOR
Un brazo de tierra que separa el Mar Menor del Mediterráneo, La Manga es famosa por sus playas interminables y su oferta deportiva, especialmente para los amantes de los deportes acuáticos. Con una laguna salada de aguas cálidas, es un destino idílico para el turismo de sol y playa.

CABO DE PALOS (CARTAGENA)
Un pintoresco pueblo de pescadores con un faro icónico, Cabo de Palos es conocido por sus aguas cristalinas, ideales para el buceo y el snorkel, además de su vibrante puerto y restaurantes de mariscos frescos. El entorno marino, protegido, ofrece un espectáculo de vida submarina incomparable.

PARQUE NATURAL DE CALBLANQUE
Este parque es un paraíso de playas vírgenes, dunas doradas y montañas escarpadas. Calblanque destaca por su biodiversidad y paisajes inalterados, siendo un refugio natural perfecto para senderistas y amantes de la naturaleza. Su costa es salvaje y tranquila, alejada del turismo masivo.

LAS MINAS Y EL PUEBLO DE PORTMÁN
Un lugar donde la historia minera de la región cobra vida. Portmán, famoso por su pasado en la extracción de minerales, es un testimonio del auge y caída de la industria minera. Las minas abandonadas y la bahía parcialmente recuperada son reflejo de su legado.

LA MANGA DEL MAR MENOR
Un brazo de tierra que separa el Mar Menor del Mediterráneo, La Manga es famosa por sus playas interminables y su oferta deportiva, especialmente para los amantes de los deportes acuáticos. Con una laguna salada de aguas cálidas, es un destino idílico para el turismo de sol y playa.

2025 NEW SEASON IN A BIG WAY!

CABO DE PALOS · NOVEMBER 1-2, 2025

We say goodbye to the 2025 season in style in Cabo de Palos. A gravel cycling event that combines sport, nature and fun without the pressure of competition. Join us in Cabo de Palos and the Calblanque Natural Park for a unique experience that goes beyond cycling. Here it’s not about getting there first, but about enjoying every moment: Two routes of 50 and 80 km on Saturday and on Sunday, don’t miss out, there’s much more: SUP paddle, snorkelling, kayaking, routes through impressive landscapes, music… and an unforgettable night party.

This event is for you if you want to close the 2025 season with good vibes, nature and new adventures.

PROGRAM

THE MINES AND THE VILLAGE OF PORTMÁN

A place where the region's mining history comes alive. Portmán, famous for its mineral extraction past, is a testament to the rise and fall of the mining industry. The abandoned mines and partially reclaimed bay are a reflection of its legacy.

LA MANGA DEL MAR MENOR

An arm of land that separates the Mar Menor from the Mediterranean, La Manga is famous for its endless beaches and its sports offer, especially for water sports lovers. With a salt lagoon with warm waters, it is an idyllic destination for sun and beach tourism.

CABO DE PALOS (CARTAGENA)

A picturesque fishing village with an iconic lighthouse, Cabo de Palos is known for its crystal-clear waters, ideal for diving and snorkelling, as well as its vibrant harbour and fresh seafood restaurants. The protected marine environment offers an unrivalled spectacle of underwater life.

CALBLANQUE NATURAL PARK

This park is a paradise of unspoilt beaches, golden dunes and rugged mountains. Calblanque stands out for its biodiversity and untouched landscapes, making it a perfect natural refuge for hikers and nature lovers. Its coast is wild and peaceful, far from mass tourism.

REGULATION Festival Cabo de Palos 2025

Learn more about the spirit of the Cabo de Palos Festival and our regulations to enjoy a unique experience in this edition.

These rules explain and develop the conditions of participation and characteristics of the IRON GRAVEL Festival Cabo de Palos event, which will take place on October 11, 2025, in Cabo de Palos, Cartagena.

Registration implies acceptance of these rules and authorization of the event’s cancellation and registration modification policy.

Regardless of the information in these regulations, all technical details can be found on the event’s official website and in the RUNNER’S GUIDE, which will be sent to all registered participants.

The proposed format is NON-COMPETITIVE. It is not a race or a walk. It is a personal challenge, in which each participant is obliged to comply at all times with the Road Safety Law and the General Traffic Regulations in force in Spain, as well as any other regulations in force along the route planned by the Organizers. Participants are not granted special priority over other road users at any time. Road safety requirements for the event are outlined in Article 7 of these Regulations.

There are no race numbers, but participants’ identification elements will be mandatory for their safety and the smooth running of the event. These elements consist of a sticker for the bicycle and helmet, personal and non-transferable identification for the participant and their bicycle.

There is no official timing, but there are maximum times and schedules for completing the course. There are cut-off times, located at checkpoints and at the refreshment points. These cut-off times are established by the organizers and will be more than sufficient for all participants, regardless of their level, to enjoy the race in the minimum physical condition necessary to tackle these distances with a low elevation.

Participants must respect these cut-off times for their own safety and the safety of the race. Failure to comply with these times means participants may continue on their own without the organizer’s support or responsibility, or they may choose the shortest or easiest route to return to the start/finish line. The cut-off times will be published in the Runner’s Dossier, which is published and announced on the official website.

In the event of withdrawal due to a breakdown that makes it impossible for a participant to return, the organizers cannot be held responsible for their recovery.

In the event of withdrawal or abandonment, the participant must first withdraw at one of the checkpoints and inform the organizers of their withdrawal.

Type of Bike. This event has been designed for gravel bikes, based on its route and format. However, the use of any type of bicycle capable of off-road riding is permitted.

The presence of e-bike versions is not contemplated in these Regulations, but participation is permitted. If a significant number of e-bike entries are received, the organizers will assess and arrange a dedicated e-bike start and time.

El itinerario recorre terreno de montaña, principalmente por pistas, caminos vecinales, algún tramo de carretera y alguna senda; cada participante debe ser plenamente consciente de la longitud y dificultad de la prueba, Por tanto, debe prever que su indumentaria, así como la condición física, sean las más apropiadas para realizar la prueba.

No hay SEÑALIZACIÓN del recorrido. La prueba se realiza con el seguimiento por GPS de un Track entregado por la Organización, aun así, en los cruces y puntos de posible confusión la Organización podrá ayudar a la navegación bien con personal voluntario o indicaciones en el terreno. Será obligatorio seguir el itinerario marcado por el track. El Track oficial y definitivo será enviado a cada participante en las semanas anteriores a la fecha del evento. Es necesario el uso de un GPS o teléfono móvil.

La salida será a las 09:30 am. La Organización valorara según el número de inscritos separar la salida de la distancia larga y corta. La hora máxima de llegada, las 15:00

Tras la salida, el grupo rodará a ritmo neutralizado y acompañados por miembros de la organización y la Policía Local durante los primeros kilómetros, hasta salir de la zona urbana de Cabo de Palos.

En caso de abandono, hay que comunicarlo lo antes posible al personal de la organización, bien en alguno de los puntos de control o bien a través del número de teléfono facilitado por la misma.

La organización podrá suspender la prueba si las condiciones meteorológicas así lo aconsejan o por otras causas de fuerza mayor. En este caso, los derechos de inscripción no serán devueltos, postergando la realización del evento en la fecha mas cercana posible.

La organización dispondrá de varios puntos de control , que contarán con bebidas y alimentos en las cantidades que se estimen como razonables dado el registro del evento. Sus ubicaciones y detalles serán especificados en la guía del participante.

Es obligación de cada participante llevar los desperdicios originados hasta estos puntos señalados por la organización o hasta meta.

The event is open to all athletes aged 18 or over on the day of the event. Registered participants confirm that they are fully informed of the event’s format and characteristics and are aware of the event’s length, difficulty, and physical demands. They confirm that they have the knowledge, experience, equipment, and physical and psychological level necessary to face and overcome potential problems related to the demands of an event of this type.

Those registered participate in the event voluntarily and under their own responsibility. For this reason, the organizing entity and company, the municipality, collaborators and employees, sponsors, and other participants are exempt from any civil liability.

Upon registration, participants automatically accept the «disclaimer and certificate of physical fitness,» which informs them of the risks involved in participating and excludes the organization from any incident or accident arising from their participation.

Participants must prioritize ethics, camaraderie, and respect for the environment above the event.

In case of emergency, participants should call one of the numbers indicated in the event information, which are exclusively for emergency use.

Participation, as a whole, is limited to a number that will be determined and posted when registration opens. For obvious safety reasons and due to the natural environment in which the race takes place, the number of participants is limited.

Registration opens on July 15, 2025, and closes on October 5, 2025, or when the maximum number of registered participants is reached. Registration can be completed through the official website (www.irongravel.com) by redirecting to the registration platform, Rockthesport.

No refunds will be issued for registration fees. Participants can purchase Cancellation Insurance during the registration process, which can be used up to 30 days before the event, allowing for a 100% refund of the amount paid.

Registration is non-transferable from one year to the next, and changes cannot be made for other events on the IRON GRAVEL calendar.

You can modify the name and distance of your registration, as well as other information, through «Your Registration» with the tracking number and email address. To make the change, go to the registration section of the website: Home – My Registration.

One week before the event, name or distance changes cannot be made. Only in justified cases may a participant’s name or distance be changed by sending an email to the organizers: info@irongravel.com.

The organizers reserve the right to cancel the event up to the day of departure if the physical safety of participants is endangered due to weather or other force majeure factors.

Todos los participantes deberán llevar la pegatina dorsal en su bicicleta y en el casco. Ambos distintivos obligatorios son primordiales para la seguridad de corredores y Organización y para un correcto desarrollo de la prueba. Identificación en avituallamientos, puntos de control y en los diversos servicios ofrecidos que no podrán ser atendidos sin la debida identificación.

All participants must carefully observe the provisions of the Road Safety Law and its regulations. The route runs almost entirely on tracks and paths, but in some sections, roads open to traffic are crossed or used, where extreme caution must be exercised and traffic regulations must be strictly observed.

Everyone registered for the race will be covered during their participation, within the established route and timetable, by at least accident insurance in accordance with Royal Decree 849/1993, of June 4, which establishes the minimum amounts for accidents involving athletes, with the guarantee of medical assistance. The organization will also maintain its own liability insurance. Although the organization is not responsible for any accidents caused by reckless or irresponsible actions on the part of the participant, it is not liable for any expenses or debts that participants may incur during the event, nor for any loss or damage to bicycles or other equipment belonging to participants. The participant releases the organization from liability for the loss or damage of personal belongings under any circumstances.

The race number assigned to each participant is non-transferable and may not be transferred to another person without the prior knowledge and authorization of the race organizer. The insurance policies issued only cover the race number holder, who will be the one listed on the registration lists.

The participant acknowledges that adequate prior training is required and that they must not suffer any injuries that could be aggravated as a result of participating in the race. Therefore, registration implies express recognition by the person registering that they meet both conditions, releasing the organization from any liability arising from failure to comply with the above. In any case, each participant assumes the consequences for their health that may arise from their participation in the race, releasing the race organizers from any liability that may arise for this reason. Likewise, participants are responsible for their physical condition, for being familiar with the route and the physical demands it entails, for obtaining medical approval of their health, and for any injuries that may be caused by their participation, personally assuming the inherent health risks posed by the physical effort required for participation.

One of the goals and objectives of the IRON GRAVEL is to showcase the rich landscape and nature of the area where the event takes place. Demonstrating that enjoying it can be compatible with sports tourism activities is one of our objectives.

The course runs largely through natural landscapes of exceptional beauty, so everyone is obliged to preserve the environment, and throwing waste outside the control areas is strictly prohibited. In order to minimize the environmental impact of the event, participants will use the containers located at the refreshment stations and strategic points to dispose of containers, wrappers, or food scraps.

IMAGE RIGHTS.

All participants waive their image rights during the event. The organizers may use images from the event for their own personal gain. The right to one’s own image is recognized in Article 18.1 of the Constitution and regulated by Law 5/1982, of May 5, on the right to honor, personal and family privacy, and one’s own image, as well as in the application of Organic Law 15/1999 on the Protection of Personal Data, of December 13.

Acceptance of these regulations implies that the participant authorizes the event organizer, IRON GRAVEL, to take photographs and film their participation and gives their consent for the dissemination and commercial and advertising exploitation of all images taken during the event, without the right to receive any type of financial compensation.
Under no circumstances will these images be used for purposes other than those indicated.

DATA PROTECTION.
In accordance with the provisions of Organic Law 15/1999, of December 13, on the Protection of Personal Data, all participant data collected in the registration form will be included in a private file belonging to the event organizers, for the exclusive management and marketing purposes of the collaborating brands. All interested parties may exercise their rights of access, rectification, erasure, and objection to the use of their data by emailing info@irongravel.com.

The mere fact of registering for this event implies acceptance of these Rules and the waiver of all rights against the Organization, waiving any legal action that may arise from your participation in the event.

The Organization reserves the right to make any necessary changes when deemed necessary for any reason, notifying such changes through the event’s usual media channels. It also reserves the right to refuse admission.

DISTANCES

50K

550+

This 50km route is perfect for those looking for an accessible but adventurous gravel experience. Suitable for intermediate level riders, it will take you through stunning coastal landscapes and paths surrounded by unspoiled nature. Discover the essence of Cabo de Palos while enjoying a unique natural environment.

360K

4.500+

Es un viaje, una aventura que te proponemos para que disfrutes de un recorrido gravel por el sur y centro de la provincia de Alicante. En modo de autosuficiencia.

980+

With 80km of pure excitement, this route challenges intermediate-level cyclists to explore even more of the stunning Mediterranean landscape. With longer and more varied sections, they will travel through protected areas and natural spaces that combine the beauty of the sea and the mountains. A route that offers the best of the environment in an unforgettable experience.

PROGRAMA

LAS MINAS Y EL PUEBLO DE PORTMÁN

Un lugar donde la historia minera de la región cobra vida. Portmán, famoso por su pasado en la extracción de minerales, es un testimonio del auge y caída de la industria minera. Las minas abandonadas y la bahía parcialmente recuperada son reflejo de su legado.

LA MANGA DEL MAR MENOR

Un brazo de tierra que separa el Mar Menor del Mediterráneo, La Manga es famosa por sus playas interminables y su oferta deportiva, especialmente para los amantes de los deportes acuáticos. Con una laguna salada de aguas cálidas, es un destino idílico para el turismo de sol y playa.

CABO DE PALOS (CARTAGENA)

Un pintoresco pueblo de pescadores con un faro icónico, Cabo de Palos es conocido por sus aguas cristalinas, ideales para el buceo y el snorkel, además de su vibrante puerto y restaurantes de mariscos frescos. El entorno marino, protegido, ofrece un espectáculo de vida submarina incomparable.

PARQUE NATURAL DE CALBLANQUE

Este parque es un paraíso de playas vírgenes, dunas doradas y montañas escarpadas. Calblanque destaca por su biodiversidad y paisajes inalterados, siendo un refugio natural perfecto para senderistas y amantes de la naturaleza. Su costa es salvaje y tranquila, alejada del turismo masivo.

REGLAMENTO IRONGRAVEL Festival Cabo de Palos 2025

Conoce más sobre el espíritu del Festival Cabo de Palos y nuestro reglamento para disfrutar de una experiencia única en esta edición.

El presente reglamento explica y desarrolla cuáles son las condiciones de participación y características del evento IRON GRAVEL Festival Cabo de Palos que tendrá lugar el día
11 de octubre de 2025, en Cabo de Palos, Cartagena.

La realización de la inscripción implica la aceptación de este reglamento y la autorización
de la política de cancelación y modificación de la inscripción del evento.

Independientemente de la información de este reglamento, todos los aspectos técnicos los encontrará en la página web oficial del evento y en la GUIA del CORREDOR que se enviará a todos los inscritos.

El formato propuesto es de carácter NO COMPETITIVO. No es una carrera, ni una marcha. Es un reto personal, donde cada participante está obligado a respetar en todo momento la Ley de Seguridad Vial y el Reglamento General de Circulación vigente en España, así como cualquier otra normativa vigente a lo largo del recorrido previsto por la Organización y no se tiene en ningún momento prioridad especial respecto a otros usuarios de las vías del itinerario. La seguridad vial a llevar a cabo en la prueba se desarrolla en el artículo 7 del presente Reglamento.

No hay DORSALES, pero sí serán de obligado cumplimiento, los elementos identificativos de los participantes, por su seguridad y por el buen desarrollo de la misma , que constan de PEGATINA para la bicicleta y para el casco, identificativas personales e intransferibles para el participante y su bicicleta.

No hay cronometraje oficial, pero si unos tiempos y horarios máximos para completar el recorrido. Existe unos tiempos de corte, situados en los puntos de control, PC- Avituallamiento, establecido por la Organización será más que suficiente para que todos los participantes, independientemente de su nivel, puedan disfrutar de la prueba con la condición física mínima necesaria para afrontar estas distancias con un desnivel bajo.

Los tiempos de corte deberán ser respetados por los participantes en aras de su propia seguridad y de la prueba. En caso de no cumplir con este horario, el participante bien podrá seguir por su cuenta sin el apoyo ni la responsabilidad del Organizador, o bien podrá escoger el trayecto más corto o fácil para volver a la Salida/Meta. Los horarios de corte se publicarán en el Dossier del Corredor publicado y anunciado en la web oficial.

En el caso de abandono por avería que imposibilite al participante, la Organización no puede hacerse responsable de la recogida del mismo.

En el caso de abandono o retirada el participante prioritariamente lo hará en alguno de los puntos de control e informando a la organización de su retirada.

Tipo de BICICLETA. Este evento ha sido diseñado por su recorrido y formato, para bicicletas tipo Gravel. No obstante, está permitido el uso de cualquier tipo de bicicleta capaz de rodar off-road.

La presencia de versiones e-bike, no está contemplada en este Reglamento, pero si está permitida la participación. Si la inscripción de e-bikes fuese considerable, la Organización valorará y gestionará una salida y horario exclusivo e-bike.

El itinerario recorre terreno de montaña, principalmente por pistas, caminos vecinales, algún tramo de carretera y alguna senda; cada participante debe ser plenamente consciente de la longitud y dificultad de la prueba, Por tanto, debe prever que su indumentaria, así como la condición física, sean las más apropiadas para realizar la prueba.

No hay SEÑALIZACIÓN del recorrido. La prueba se realiza con el seguimiento por GPS de un Track entregado por la Organización, aun así, en los cruces y puntos de posible confusión la Organización podrá ayudar a la navegación bien con personal voluntario o indicaciones en el terreno. Será obligatorio seguir el itinerario marcado por el track. El Track oficial y definitivo será enviado a cada participante en las semanas anteriores a la fecha del evento. Es necesario el uso de un GPS o teléfono móvil.

La salida será a las 09:30 am. La Organización valorara según el número de inscritos separar la salida de la distancia larga y corta. La hora máxima de llegada, las 15:00 Tras la salida, el grupo rodará a ritmo neutralizado y acompañados por miembros de la organización y la Policía Local durante los primeros kilómetros, hasta salir de la zona urbana de Cabo de Palos.

En caso de abandono, hay que comunicarlo lo antes posible al personal de la organización, bien en alguno de los puntos de control o bien a través del número de teléfono facilitado por la misma.

La organización podrá suspender la prueba si las condiciones meteorológicas así lo aconsejan o por otras causas de fuerza mayor. En este caso, los derechos de inscripción no serán devueltos, postergando la realización del evento en la fecha mas cercana posible.

La organización dispondrá de varios puntos de control , que contarán con bebidas y alimentos en las cantidades que se estimen como razonables dado el registro del evento. Sus ubicaciones y detalles serán especificados en la guía del participante.

Es obligación de cada participante llevar los desperdicios originados hasta estos puntos
señalados por la organización o hasta meta.

La prueba está abierta a todos los deportistas mayores de 18 años cumplidos el día de la prueba. Los participantes inscritos confirman estar plenamente informados del formato y características del evento y son conscientes de la longitud, dificultad y exigencia física de la prueba. Confirman disponer de los conocimientos, experiencia, material, nivel físico y psicológico necesarios para afrontar y superar posibles problemas relacionados con las exigencias de una prueba de este tipo.

Los inscritos participan en el evento de forma voluntaria y bajo su responsabilidad. Por este motivo, la entidad y la empresa organizadora, el municipio, los colaboradores y trabajadores, los patrocinadores y los demás participantes quedan libres de cualquier responsabilidad civil.

Los participantes aceptan automáticamente al inscribirse el “descargo de responsabilidad y el certificado de aptitud física” que informa de los riesgos que conlleva la participación y excluye a la organización en caso de cualquier incidencia, accidente derivado de su participación.

Los participantes deben priorizar la ética, el compañerismo, el respeto al entorno y al medio ambiente por encima del evento.

En caso de emergencia, los participantes deben llamar a alguno de los teléfonos que se les indicará en la ficha técnica, teléfonos exclusivamente de emergencia.

La participación, en su conjunto global de participantes, está limitada a un número que quedará determinado y expuesto en el momento de apertura de las inscripciones. Por motivos obvios de seguridad y por el entorno natural en el que transcurre la prueba, el número de participantes es limitado.

Para recoger la bolsa del corredor con el dorsal, será imprescindible la identificación por parte del participante, mediante documento identificativo, DNI, Pasaporte, licencia federativa.

El plazo de inscripción se abre el día 15 de julio del 2025 y finalizará el 5 de octubre de 2025 o en su defecto cuando se alcance el número máximo de inscritos. La inscripción se podrá realizar a través de la página web oficial del sitio (www.irongravel.com) redirigidos a la web plataforma de inscripciones, Rockthesport.

No se harán devoluciones monetarias de la inscripción. Cada participante puede contratar un Seguro de Cancelación, en el mismo proceso de inscripción, pudiendo hacer uso del mismo hasta 30 días antes del evento, haciendo posible el reembolso del 100% del importe pagado.

La inscripción no es transferible de un año para otro, ni se harán cambios por otros eventos del calendario IRON GRAVEL.

Podéis modificar el nombre y la distancia de la inscripción, así como otros datos, a través de “Vuestra inscripción” con el localizador y e-mail. Para hacer el cambio, tienes que ir dentro de la web al apartado de inscripciones: Inicio – Mi inscripción.

Una semana antes del evento, no se podrán realizar cambios de nombre o distancia. Solo en caso justificado, se podrá solicitar un cambio de nombre o de distancia del participante enviado e-mail a la organización: info@irongravel.com

La organización se guarda el derecho de cancelar el evento hasta el mismo día de la salida si la integridad física de los participantes está en peligro por motivos meteorológicos u otros factores de fuerza mayor.

Todos los participantes deberán llevar la pegatina dorsal en su bicicleta y en el casco. Ambos distintivos obligatorios son primordiales para la seguridad de corredores y Organización y para un correcto desarrollo de la prueba. Identificación en avituallamientos, puntos de control y en los diversos servicios ofrecidos que no podrán ser atendidos sin la debida identificación.

Todos los participantes deberán observar atentamente las disposiciones de la Ley de Seguridad Vial y su reglamento. El recorrido discurre casi en su totalidad por pistas y caminos, pero en algunos tramos se cruzan o utilizan carreteras abiertas al tráfico rodado, dónde debemos extremar la precaución y cumplir rigurosamente con las normas de circulación.

Toda persona inscrita en la prueba estará cubierta durante su participación, dentro del recorrido y horarios establecidos, como mínimo por un seguro de accidentes según. el R.
D. 849/1993, de 4 de junio, que establece los capitales mínimos para accidentes de deportistas, con la garantía de asistencia sanitaria. El participante exime a la organización de responsabilidad por pérdida o deterioro de objetos personales por cualquier circunstancia.

EL DORSAL ATRIBUIDO A CADA PARTICIPANTE ES INTRANSFERIBLE, SIN QUE SE PUEDA CEDER A OTRA PERSONA SIN CONOCIMIENTO Y AUTORIZACIÓN PREVIA DE LA ORGANIZACIÓN DE LA PRUEBA. LOS SEGUROS TRAMITADOS SOLAMENTE CUBREN AL TITULAR DEL DORSAL, QUE SERÁ EL QUE APAREZCA EN LOS LISTADOS DE INSCRITOS.

El participante conoce que se requiere un entrenamiento previo adecuado y no padecer lesión alguna que pueda agravarse como consecuencia de la realización de la prueba, por lo que la inscripción implica el reconocimiento expreso por parte de quien la realiza de cumplir ambas condiciones, eximiendo a la organización de cualquier responsabilidad derivada del incumplimiento de todo lo anterior. En cualquier caso, cada participante en la prueba asume las consecuencias que sobre su salud pudieran derivarse de su participación en la prueba, eximiendo a la Organización de la misma de cualquier tipo de responsabilidad que por tal motivo pudiera derivarse. Asimismo, se responsabiliza del estado de su condición física, de conocer el recorrido y la exigencia física que conlleva, de la comprobación médica de su salud, de los daños que pudiera ocasionarse por su participación, asumiendo personalmente el riesgo inherente para la salud que supone el esfuerzo físico requerido para la participación.

Uno de los objetivos y deseos del IRON GRAVEL es mostrar la riqueza en materia paisajística y de naturaleza que tiene la zona por donde transcurre el evento. Demostrar que el disfrute de la misma puede ser compatible con actividades de turismo deportivo es uno de nuestros objetivos.

MONITORING 2024

Monnegre

Monnegre is a unique town located in the north of the municipality of Alicante. This enclave, which forms part of the old Alicante orchard, is characterised by its slopes, ravines and orchards, as well as by old farmhouses and numerous historical hydraulic infrastructures, such as the remains of the Roman aqueduct that carried water from Tibi to Alicante.

More info

Canteras de Arcilla de Agost

Agost is a town in Alicante known for its historic pottery tradition, based on the white clay quarries that surround it. These clays, extracted since ancient times, have been essential for the production of unique ceramic pieces, such as botijos and jugs. The geological wealth of the area has not only promoted local crafts, but has also made Agost a cultural and tourist reference in the province of Alicante.

More info

P.N. Salinas Santa Pola

The Salinas de Santa Pola is a protected natural area in Spain located in the municipality of Santa Pola, which is part of the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community.

More info

P.N. Lagunas La Mata y Torrevieja

The Park is made up of two main lagoons: La Mata and Torrevieja, separated by a strip of land known as "El Chaparral". The Torrevieja lagoon is especially notable for the characteristic pink colour of its waters. It has marked hiking and cycling routes, allowing visitors to explore its landscapes and observe the local fauna.

More info

Embalse de La Pedrera

It is located in the municipality of Orihuela. It is 61 metres high and 716 metres long and plays a crucial role in the regulation and distribution of water from the Tajo-Segura Transfer. In addition to its hydraulic function, the La Pedrera Reservoir has become a tourist attraction due to the striking turquoise colour of its waters and the natural environment that surrounds it.

More info

Vía verde del Río Segura

Natural corridor that follows the course of the Segura River, offering cyclists and hikers a route that connects various towns in the province of Alicante. The route covers approximately 10 kilometres, crossing traditional orchard areas and river groves.

El Cabezo de la Sal, Pinoso

Cabezo de la Sal, located in Pinoso, is a unique geological formation known as a Triassic diapir. It originated approximately 250 million years ago, when saline materials rose through the upper layers of the Earth's crust, creating a mountain of rock salt, anhydrite, gypsum and clays. With an altitude of 893 meters, it stands out for its rounded shape and reddish colors, becoming an icon of the local landscape.

More info

Vía verde La Chicharra

The Chicharra Green Route is a route that takes advantage of the old narrow-gauge railway line known as "El Chicharra". Historical heritage: Along the route, you can see vestiges of the old railway, such as stations, bridges and tunnels, which evoke the railway history of the region. Natural environment: The green route crosses landscapes characteristic of the Alicante interior.

Sierra de El Carche

The Sierra del Carche, located in the Region of Murcia, is a natural area, declared a Regional Park in 2003, covering approximately 5,942 hectares and forming part of the Prebetic system. Its highest point is Pico de la Madama, which reaches 1,372 metres above sea level, making it one of the highest peaks in the region. The Cabezo de la Rosa salt diapir stands out, a geological structure of great interest.

Sierra de Enguera, Pico Caroche y la Muela de Cortes

The region that includes the Sierra de Enguera, Pico Caroche and Muela de Cortes, located in the Valencian Community, offers a landscape and ecological diversity of great interest.

Sierra de Tous

The Tous Reservoir, located in the province of Valencia, is surrounded by a series of mountain formations that contribute to its unique landscape. To the north and east of the reservoir are the Tous, Murta and Umbria mountain ranges. These mountain ranges not only add scenic value to the surroundings of the Tous Reservoir, but also play a crucial role in the conservation of biodiversity and in regulating the microclimate of the region.

Monnegre

Monnegre es una entidad singular de población situada al norte del término municipal de Alicante. Este enclave, que forma parte de la antigua huerta alicantina, se caracteriza por sus laderas, barrancos y huertas, así como por las viejas casas de labranza y numerosas infraestructuras hidráulicas históricas, como los vestigios del acueducto romano que llevaba agua desde Tibi hasta Alicante.

Más info

Canteras de Arcilla de Agost

Agost es una localidad alicantina reconocida por su histórica tradición alfarera, sustentada en las canteras de arcilla blanca que la rodean. Estas arcillas, extraídas desde tiempos remotos, han sido fundamentales para la elaboración de piezas cerámicas únicas, como botijos y cántaros. La riqueza geológica de la zona no solo ha impulsado la artesanía local, sino que también ha convertido a Agost en un referente cultural y turístico en la provincia de Alicante.

Más info

P.N. Salinas Santa Pola

Las Salinas de Santa Pola es un espacio natural protegido español situado en el término municipal de Santa Pola, que forma parte de la provincia de Alicante, en la Comunidad Valenciana.

Más info

P.N. Lagunas La Mata y Torrevieja

El Parque está compuesto por dos lagunas principales: La Mata y Torrevieja, separadas por una franja de terreno conocida como "El Chaparral". La laguna de Torrevieja es especialmente notable por el característico color rosado de sus aguas. Cuenta con rutas señalizadas para senderismo y ciclismo, permitiendo a los visitantes explorar sus paisajes y observar la fauna local.

Más info

Embalse de La Pedrera

Se sitúa en el término municipal de Orihuela. Tiene una altura de 61 metros y una longitud de 716 metros. y desempeña un papel crucial en la regulación y distribución de las aguas provenientes del Trasvase Tajo-Segura,.Además de su función hidráulica, el Embalse de La Pedrera se ha convertido en un atractivo turístico debido al llamativo color turquesa de sus aguas y al entorno natural que lo rodea.

Más info

Vía verde del Río Segura

Corredor natural que sigue el curso del río Segura, ofreciendo a ciclistas y senderistas una ruta que conecta diversas localidades de la provincia de Alicante. Se recorren aproximadamente 10 kilómetros, atravesando zonas de huerta tradicional y sotos fluviales.

El Cabezo de la Sal, Pinoso

Ubicado en Pinoso, es una formación geológica singular conocida como diapiro triásico. Se originó hace aproximadamente 250 millones de años, cuando materiales salinos ascendieron a través de las capas superiores de la corteza terrestre, creando una montaña de sal gema, anhidrita, yeso y arcillas. Con una altitud de 893 metros, destaca por su forma redondeada y colores rojizos, convirtiéndose en un icono del paisaje local.

Más info

Vía verde La Chicharra

La Vía Verde del Chicharra es una ruta que aprovecha el antiguo trazado del ferrocarril de vía estrecha conocido como "El Chicharra". Patrimonio histórico: A lo largo de la ruta, se pueden observar vestigios del antiguo ferrocarril, como estaciones, puentes y túneles, que evocan la historia ferroviaria de la región. Entorno natural: La vía verde atraviesa paisajes característicos del interior alicantino.

Sierra de El Carche

La Sierra del Carche, situada en la Región de Murcia, es un espacio natural, declarado Parque Regional en 2003, abarca aproximadamente 5.942 hectáreas y forma parte del sistema Prebético. Su punto más elevado es el Pico de la Madama, que alcanza los 1.372 metros sobre el nivel del mar, convirtiéndose en una de las cumbres más altas de la región. Destaca el diapiro salino del Cabezo de la Rosa, una estructura geológica de gran interés.

Sierra de Enguera, Pico Caroche y la Muela de Cortes

La región que abarca la Sierra de Enguera, el Pico Caroche y la Muela de Cortes, situada en la Comunidad Valenciana, ofrece una diversidad paisajística y ecológica de gran interés.

Sierra de Tous

El Pantano de Tous, ubicado en la provincia de Valencia, está rodeado por una serie de formaciones montañosas que contribuyen a su singular paisaje. Al norte y este del embalse se encuentran las sierras de Tous, Murta y de la Umbria Estas sierras no solo aportan valor paisajístico al entorno del Pantano de Tous, sino que también desempeñan un papel crucial en la conservación de la biodiversidad y en la regulación del microclima de la región.

MONITORING 2024

Monnegre

Monnegre is a unique town located in the north of the municipality of Alicante. This enclave, which forms part of the old Alicante orchard, is characterised by its slopes, ravines and orchards, as well as by old farmhouses and numerous historical hydraulic infrastructures, such as the remains of the Roman aqueduct that carried water from Tibi to Alicante.

More info

Canteras de Arcilla de Agost

Agost is a town in Alicante known for its historic pottery tradition, based on the white clay quarries that surround it. These clays, extracted since ancient times, have been essential for the production of unique ceramic pieces, such as botijos and jugs. The geological wealth of the area has not only promoted local crafts, but has also made Agost a cultural and tourist reference in the province of Alicante.

More info

P.N. Salinas Santa Pola

The Salinas de Santa Pola is a protected natural area in Spain located in the municipality of Santa Pola, which is part of the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community.

More info

El Cabezo de la Sal, Pinoso

Cabezo de la Sal, located in Pinoso, is a unique geological formation known as a Triassic diapir. It originated approximately 250 million years ago, when saline materials rose through the upper layers of the Earth's crust, creating a mountain of rock salt, anhydrite, gypsum and clays. With an altitude of 893 meters, it stands out for its rounded shape and reddish colors, becoming an icon of the local landscape.

More info

Vía verde La Chicharra

The Chicharra Green Route is a route that takes advantage of the old narrow-gauge railway line known as "El Chicharra". Historical heritage: Along the route, you can see vestiges of the old railway, such as stations, bridges and tunnels, which evoke the railway history of the region. Natural environment: The green route crosses landscapes characteristic of the Alicante interior.

Monnegre

Monnegre is a unique town located in the north of the municipality of Alicante. This enclave, which forms part of the old Alicante orchard, is characterised by its slopes, ravines and orchards, as well as by old farmhouses and numerous historical hydraulic infrastructures, such as the remains of the Roman aqueduct that carried water from Tibi to Alicante.

More info

Canteras de Arcilla de Agost

Agost is a town in Alicante known for its historic pottery tradition, based on the white clay quarries that surround it. These clays, extracted since ancient times, have been essential for the production of unique ceramic pieces, such as botijos and jugs. The geological wealth of the area has not only promoted local crafts, but has also made Agost a cultural and tourist reference in the province of Alicante.

More info

Rambla de Rambuchar

The Rambla de Rambuchar is an intermittent watercourse that originates in the Sierra del Maigmó, at an altitude of 1,100 metres. Along its route, it collects water from the Maigmó and Cid mountain ranges, as well as from other lower elevations. It is a natural enclave of interest for outdoor activities, such as hiking and mountain biking, offering landscapes characteristic of the region and a direct connection with nature.

P.N. Salinas Santa Pola

The Salinas de Santa Pola is a protected natural area in Spain located in the municipality of Santa Pola, which is part of the province of Alicante, in the Valencian Community.

More info

Parque Natural del Hondo

The El Hondo Natural Park, located between the municipalities of Elche and Crevillente in the province of Alicante, is one of the main wetlands in the Valencian Community. This natural space is part of the old lagoon of Elche and is made up of reservoirs, ponds and salt marshes that create an ideal habitat for a great diversity of species.

More info

Sierra de Albatera y Crevillente

The Sierra de Albatera y Crevillente is a mountain range located in the province of Alicante. Its peaks offer panoramic views of the Bajo Vinalopó region and the Vega Baja del Segura, making them points of interest for hiking and nature lovers. In addition to its scenic value, the Sierra de Albatera y Crevillente is home to elements of historical and cultural interest, such as the Els Pontets aqueduct.

More info

Pantano de Elche

The Elche Reservoir is one of the oldest arch dams in Europe. This reservoir, located on the Vinalopó River, is a natural space of great ecological and scenic value. The "Water Route" is an environmental trail that runs through the reservoir's surroundings, allowing visitors to learn about the hydraulic history of the area and enjoy its biodiversity.

IRON GRAVEL is a BRAND. A BRAND that organizes a series of gravel events, currently there are 2. The IG360 held in Alicante city and the IRON GRAVEL in Busot. Both events have different distances and consist of cycling in self-sufficiency mode, non-competitive, a Track delivered by the organization to those registered. There is no time limit or classifications, but there is a time limit to complete the track.

Due to the characteristics of the course, a Gravel type bike (curved handlebars) is recommended, but any type of bike capable of off-road riding is allowed.

It depends on the event chosen and your level, but a width between 38 and 42 mm would be suitable and recommended for all events.

We deal with events with the IRON GRAVEL signature, and therefore we are always going to find ourselves at some point with gradients that exceed 20%. For this reason, the recommended gearing must be very wide. The configuration with two chainrings would be a 32/42 with the large 36 or 42 sprocket, and with single chainring a 40 x 50.

Yes, although there are few kilometers on the road, you must respect the rules and the Road Safety Law.

Yes, although given the non-competitive nature of the event, these times are more than enough to complete it with a physical level adapted to the route.

The idea of the events organized by IRON GRAVEL is based on self-sufficiency, but we set up, taking advantage of the control points, a basic provisioning. Please read the Runner’s Guide in each event, where these points will be well informed.

Over 18 years old, no federation license is required. Adventurous cyclists eager for new experiences in an environment that will surprise them.

Yes, all our events are organized with the navigation formula, and the absence of signaling is total. The route has no markings or beacons to follow. It is mandatory, necessary and essential GPS and auxiliary battery to hold all the hours you calculate for your event.

Yes, the area where the final party will be held will be open to the general public.

360 DEGREES,
360 KILOMETRES,
36 HOURS.

ALICANTE · APRIL 30 – MAY 3, 2026

The IG360 is not a competition, it cannot even be classified as a cycle-touring event. It is a trip, an adventure that we propose so that you can enjoy a gravel route through the province of Alicante, Murcia, Albacete and Valencia, depending on your choice. In self-sufficiency mode, you must complete the route autonomously, by following a GPS track and complying with all the Rules of the Highway Code. Four distance options: the new one, 720 kms with a cumulative distance of 11,300+ through the provinces of Alicante and Valencia, 360 kms with a cumulative distance of 4,500+, a third option of 200 kms and 2,500+ and the 100 kms with a cumulative distance of 1,600+.

Let yourself be surprised by a route that links all kinds of terrain and surfaces with a unique and native landscape diversity.

Don’t be in a hurry, the success of completing the challenge is only yours. Enjoy passing through natural spaces of exceptional beauty and protection such as the Natural Park of les Salines de Santa Pola, P.N. de las Lagunas de la Mata and Torrevieja, the Sierra Escalona in Orihuela, the greenways of the Segura and Xixarra rivers. The mouth of the Segura, Monte Coto de Pinoso, the Algezares of the Elx reservoir…

See classifieds IG360

REGISTRATION COMING SOON…

PROGRAM

REGULATIONS IG360 2026

Learn more about the spirit of IG360 and our regulations to enjoy a unique experience in the first edition.

These regulations explain and develop the conditions of participation and characteristics of the IG 360 event, which will take place on April 30th and May 1st, 2nd, and 3rd, 2026, in the city of Alicante.

Registration implies acceptance of these regulations and authorization of the event’s cancellation and registration modification policy.

Regardless of the information in these regulations, all technical details can be found on the event’s official website, www.irongravel.com, and in the RUNNER’S GUIDE, which will be sent to all registered participants.

The proposed format is NON-COMPETITIVE. It is not a race or a walk. It is a personal challenge, in which each participant is obliged to comply at all times with the Road Safety Law and the General Traffic Regulations in force in Spain, as well as any other regulations in force along the route planned by the Organization. Participants are not granted special priority over other road users. Road safety requirements for the event are outlined in Article 7 of these Regulations.

There are no race numbers, but participants’ identification elements are mandatory for their safety and the smooth running of the event. A sticker for the bicycle and cap, if present, and other personal and non-transferable identification marks for the participant and their bicycle are required. Each participant will also be required to carry a tracker or geolocator, which will be delivered in their runner’s bag as a 50-euro deposit, which will be refundable at the end of the event and upon return of the race.

There is a timekeeping system and cut-off times. These cut-off times, set at the checkpoints (PCs) by the Organizers, will be more than sufficient for all participants, with the minimum level required for this type of event and according to mileage, to complete and enjoy the race.

Participants must respect the cut-off times for their own safety and the race’s safety. Failure to comply with this schedule means participants may continue on their own without the Organizer’s support or responsibility, or they may choose the shortest or easiest route back to Alicante. The cut-off times will be published in the Runner’s Dossier, which is published and announced on the official website.

In the event of withdrawal due to a breakdown that makes it impossible for the participant to complete the race, the Organizers cannot be held responsible for collecting the ticket.

In the event of withdrawal or abandonment, the participant must first withdraw at one of the checkpoints and inform the organizers of their withdrawal.

TYPE OF BICYCLE. This event has been designed for gravel-type bicycles, based on its route and format. However, the use of any type of bicycle capable of off-road riding is permitted.

The presence of e-bike versions is not contemplated in these Regulations. If the demand for e-bike participation is significant, the organizers will assess and manage their presence.

The route covers a wide variety of terrain, including roads, paths, trails, and some trails. Each participant must be fully aware of the length and difficulty of the race, which may take place partly at night, under possible cold, rainy, and windy weather conditions. Therefore, participants must ensure that their clothing and physical condition are appropriate for the race.

There are no route markings. The race is conducted using GPS tracking provided by the organizers. Participants must follow the route marked on the track. The official and final track will be sent to each participant in the weeks prior to the event. A GPS, mobile phone, and backup battery are required.

You can and should consult the event’s technical sheets for the four distances: 720, 360, 200, and 100 km.

The dates and departure times for the four distances are:
IG720, Thursday, April 30, at 7:00 a.m.
IG360, Saturday, May 2, at 5:00 a.m.
IG200, Saturday, May 2, at 7:00 a.m.
IG100, Saturday, May 2, at 9:00 a.m.

The maximum dates and times for the four distances are:
IG720, Sunday, April 6, at 2:00 PM
IG360, Sunday, April 6, at 2:00 PM
IG200, Saturday, April 5, at 10:00 PM
IG100, Saturday, April 5, at 7:00 PM

After the start, the group will ride at a neutral pace, accompanied by members of the organization and the local police, for the first few kilometers, until reaching the point indicated on the technical sheet.

Lights are mandatory. The start times and safe riding require the use of front and rear lights.

In the event of withdrawal, please notify the organization staff as soon as possible, either at one of the checkpoints or by calling the phone number provided by the organization.
The organization may cancel the race if weather conditions so advise or for other reasons beyond its control.

In this case, registration fees will not be refunded.
The race is run within a maximum time limit, in a single stage, and on a self-sufficient basis. Therefore, each participant must be able to organize and guide their own survival between the different checkpoints, both from a nutritional, clothing, and safety standpoint.

For support, the organizers will have several checkpoints, which will have food and beverages in quantities deemed reasonable given the event’s size. For the 720-km distance, there are virtual checkpoints without refreshments for the remaining distances: three checkpoints with refreshments at the 360-km distance, two at the 200-km distance, and one at the 100-km distance. Their locations and details will be specified in the participant guide.

Each participant is required to take their waste to these checkpoints designated by the organizers or to the finish line.

The event is open to all athletes over the age of 18 on the day of the event. Registered participants confirm that they are fully informed of the format and characteristics of the IG360 and are aware of the length, difficulty, and physical demands of the event. They confirm that they have the knowledge, experience, equipment, and physical and psychological level necessary to face and overcome potential problems related to the demands of a non-stop long-distance event.

Those registered participate in the event voluntarily and under their own responsibility. For this reason, the organizing entity and company, the municipality, collaborators and employees, sponsors, and other participants are exempt from any civil liability.

Upon registration, participants automatically accept the «disclaimer and certificate of physical fitness,» which informs them of the risks involved in participating and excludes the organization from any incident or accident arising from their participation.

Participants must prioritize ethics, camaraderie, and respect for the environment above the event.

In case of emergency, participants must call one of the numbers indicated on the race information sheet, which are exclusively for emergency use.

Participation, as a whole, is limited to a number that will be determined and posted when registration opens. For obvious safety reasons and due to the natural environment in which the race takes place, the number of participants is limited.

To collect the runner’s bag with the race number, the participant must provide identification (such as an ID card, passport, or federation license).

Registration opens on October 22, 2025, and will close on April 22, 2026, or when the maximum number of registered participants is reached. Registration can be completed through the official website www.irongravel.com, which will redirect you to the registration platform, Rockthesport.

Registration for the different distances of IRON GRAVEL 360 Alicante 2026 will be governed by a price tiered system based on the registration date, offering advantageous conditions to those who formalize their participation in advance.

5.1. Final registration price:

  • IG100 → €80
  • IG200 → €120
  • IG360 → €150
  • IG720 → €230

5.2. Introductory Offer
During the first 24 hours after the official registration period opens, participants will be able to benefit from a special 50% discount on the corresponding fare for each distance.

5.3. Price Tiers
Once the initial offer closes, the following price tiers will be applied in chronological order:

Tier 1: until December 31, 2025

  • IG100 → €55
  • IG200 → €85
  • IG360 → €110
  • IG720 Ultra → €160

Tier 2: from January 1 to March 1, 2026

  • IG100 → €69
  • IG200 → €99
  • IG360 → €129
  • IG720 → €189

Tier 3 (final): from March 2, 2026, until the final registration deadline.

  • IG100: €80
  • IG200: €120
  • IG360: €150
  • IG720: €225

No refunds will be issued for registration fees. Participants can purchase Cancellation Insurance during the registration process. This insurance can be used up to 30 days before the event, allowing for a 100% refund of the amount paid.

Registration is non-transferable from one year to the next, and changes cannot be made for other events on the IRON GRAVEL calendar.

You can change the name and distance of your registration, as well as other information, through «Your Registration» with the tracking number and email address. To make the change, go to the registration section of the website: Home – My Registration.

One week before the event, changes to the name or distance cannot be made. Only in justified cases may a change of name or distance be requested by sending an email to the organizers: info@irongravel.com.

The organizers reserve the right to cancel the event up to the day of departure if the physical safety of participants is endangered due to weather or other force majeure factors.

All participants must carry all items provided by the Organization in their runner’s bag: cap, sticker, wristband, etc. These mandatory badges are essential for the safety of runners and the Organization and for the proper conduct of the race. Identification is required at refreshment stations, checkpoints, and at the various services offered, which cannot be accessed without proper identification.

The tracker, a geolocator, will be delivered in the runner’s bag with a €50 deposit, which will be returned at the finish line after returning it in perfect condition.

Given the self-sufficiency nature of the race, and despite the fact that it will have several refreshment points, each participant must plan for enough food and drinks to complete the course.

Mandatory equipment:

  • Approved hard hat
  • GPS
  • Phone
  • Auxiliary battery for both devices
  • Front and rear lights
  • Waterproof rain jacket
  • Thermal blanket and whistle
  • Basic tool kit and spare parts

Mandatory identification and safety equipment may be checked by members of the organization at the start and finish and at random throughout the course.

All participants must carefully observe the provisions of the Road Safety Law and its regulations. The route runs almost entirely on tracks and paths, but in some sections, roads open to traffic are crossed or used, where extreme caution must be exercised and traffic regulations strictly adhere to.

Everyone registered for the race will be covered during their participation, within the established route and timetable, by at least accident insurance in accordance with Royal Decree 849/1993, of June 4, which establishes the minimum capital for accidents involving athletes, with the guarantee of medical assistance. The organization will also maintain its own liability insurance.

Although the organization is not responsible for any accident caused by or suffered by the participant due to reckless or irresponsible actions, it is not liable for any expenses or debts that participants may incur during the event, nor for any loss or damage to bicycles or other equipment. The participant releases the organization from liability for the loss or damage to personal belongings under any circumstances.

The race number assigned to each participant is non-transferable and may not be transferred to another person without the prior knowledge and authorization of the race organizers. The insurance policies issued only cover the race number holder, who will be the one appearing on the registration lists.

Participants acknowledge that adequate prior training is required, as well as the right to be free of any injuries that could be aggravated as a result of participating in the event. Therefore, registration implies express recognition by the person registering that both conditions are met, exempting the organizers from any liability arising from failure to do so. In any case, each participant assumes any consequences to their health that may arise from their participation in the event, exempting the organizers from any liability that may arise for this reason. Participants are also responsible for their physical condition, for being familiar with the route and the physical demands it entails, for obtaining a medical examination of their health, and for any injuries that may be caused by their participation. Participants personally assume the inherent risk to their health posed by the physical effort required for participation.

One of the goals and objectives of IG 360 is to showcase the rich landscape and nature of the province of Alicante. Demonstrating that enjoying it can be compatible with sports tourism activities is one of our objectives.

The route runs largely through natural landscapes of exceptional beauty, so everyone is obliged to preserve the environment, and throwing waste outside the control areas is strictly prohibited. In order to minimize the environmental impact of the race, participants will use the containers located at the refreshment stations and strategic points to dispose of containers, wrappers, or food scraps.

IMAGE RIGHTS.
All participants waive their image rights during the event. The organizers may use images from the event for their own personal gain. The right to one’s own image is recognized in Article 18.1 of the Constitution and regulated by Law 5/1982, of May 5, on the right to honor, personal and family privacy, and one’s own image, as well as in the application of Organic Law 15/1999 on the Protection of Personal Data, of December 13.

Acceptance of these regulations implies that the participant authorizes the event organizer, IRON GRAVEL, to take photographs and film their participation and gives their consent for the dissemination and commercial and advertising exploitation of all images taken during the event, without the right to receive any type of financial compensation.

Under no circumstances will images be used for purposes other than those indicated.

DATA PROTECTION.

For this reason, I attend voluntarily and under my own responsibility, fully assuming the risks and consequences arising from such participation. Therefore, I release the organization, collaborators, sponsors, and other participants from any liability for any physical or material harm that may occur to me.
